milestone: Durable ordinary time snoozes waiting for native notification space
status: Implemented and verified within scoped Core and iPhone/iPad Simulator acceptance; wider Px remains incomplete

contracts.cache: Additive optional timeSnoozes metadata, maximum128 version1 records. Identity/account/delivery epoch/task/spec/signature/original instant/chosen fire instant/phase/revision only; no titles, notes, credentials or geometry.
contracts.transport: No task, shared backend, preference schema or native notification format changes. Metadata is excluded from portable work exports, sync mutations and widget payloads. Existing encrypted account recovery can retain it.
contracts.authority: New intents require explicit current notification input. Local app preferences hold a separately allocated delivery epoch, rotated on delivery disable or successful sign-out. This is not a credential or secure hardware identity.
contracts.recovery: Persist chosen instant before admission; persist reservation before native add. Only proven noRoom returns to queued. Exact pending native proof adopts installed request. Ambiguous absent reserved submission closes; installed/delivered/missing requests never rearm. No catch-up after expiry.
contracts.mutations: Durable revisions merge with the last saved cache; missing/older restored metadata cannot introduce a new queued alert or rewind existing state. Current accessible tasks/occurrence plus epoch/account/delivery checks close obsolete intents. Expired records free bounded capacity before new admission.
contracts.performance: Current Store caches accessible-task projection, epoch and clock once per recovery pass; Mac refresh hydration/admission now coalesces like iOS.

native.scope: Exact disposable DEBUG app and synthetic notification input routed through normal Store handler. Genuine app-owned native pending queue filled with60 unrelated synthetic reservations, normal task refresh may add its own request. Real cache-write failure injection preserves snapshot. Explicit snooze durably remains queued; full app termination/relaunch keeps fire instant. Releasing native capacity installs exactly one matching ordinary snooze at the same time. Task tables unchanged. Third launch explicitly closes only test intent/removes blockers.
native.limits: Synthetic action input is not a real OS-delivered action or timer delivery. iPad and first phone run precede only the Store projection-caching optimization; final phone and final Mac build include current Store. No visual redesign or new production screen.

macBuild.scope: Current independently owned Mac app and extensions compile; Mac desktop is locked, no live Mac Notification Center/action/accessibility acceptance claimed.

initialFailedNativeRun.reason: Test demanded exactly60 pending requests while normal reminder refresh could add the task original. Test now proves at least60 and exercises actual capacity deferral; production queue limit remains60.

captureScope: Unmodified synthetic native fixture screenshots and actual saved recovery snapshots. Phone/iPad layouts inspected; screenshots are scoped fixture evidence, not spoken/physical delivery proof.

installations.status: removed exact unsigned isolated Mac product

cleanup.preserved: Current accepted results, exported snapshots/captures, every log/summary, source and reusable build caches; real app installations and all real task data untouched

openAcceptance: Actual notification UI action/delivery walkthrough for this new ordinary waiting path, physical/background delivery and Mac live UI/VoiceOver are not proven here.
Same-installation restart only; reinstall, OS app-data/backup migration, hardware power loss, general downgrade/older-client rollout and remote delivery remain outside this milestone.
No promise of submission while the app stays closed and native queue has no room. Opening after chosen fire instant does not produce a catch-up alert.
